<div class="card-body">
'''Blizzard Walker''' is a [[Dark]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊＊＊ブリザード・ウォーカー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２名のパイロットと８名の乗客を搭乗させられる。対：損耗＜４。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Blizzard-Walker-PSA-147361092.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">密閉型の全地形対応装甲トランスポート。通称インペリアル・ウォーカー。帝国軍の兵器群の中でも特に凶悪で、人々から恐れられている。全高15.5m。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blizzard Walker.

'''Card text:'''
May add 2 pilots and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition < 4.

'''Lore:'''
An enclosed all-terrain armored transport, commonly called an Imperial walker. Especially vicious among Imperial weapons, and feared. 15.5 m tall.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blizzard Walker]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
